thin_margin_catalog.history: original observed history retained; cost change is current evidence

low_inventory_catalog.history: original history retained; current stock contraction is explicit fixture state

scheduled_campaign_decay.apply_to: all campaigns identically in all arms
scheduled_campaign_decay.planner_access: observed outcomes only, never schedule or quality coefficient

pending_intervention_window.prior_action: first policy-eligible search boost from deterministic prior planning
pending_intervention_window.prior_approval: exact operator approval through durable executor

prior_intervention_followed_by_adverse_o.measurement: real sampled window via existing worker, not a fabricated outcome

shared_prior_rule: Every arm, including no new intervention, receives the same actual prior action and exogenous fixture conditions. Prior actions are excluded from evaluation-period action counts and reported separately. Setup failure is retained, not resampled.
warmup_clarification: Evaluation lasts 10 days after any preregistered warmup. Existing goal starts before warmup and is explicitly revised to end at warmup+10 days. Count target equals already-observed current count plus ceiling(observed prior-seven-day daily mean * 10 * factor). Report incremental objective outcomes and target separately from the goal cumulative total. No future outcomes determine targets.
warmup_budget_rule: Original total/daily caps apply throughout warmup and evaluation. Prior spend/reservations are retained, not reset. Starting available balances must match across arms.
warmup_review_rule: A sampled adverse prior may pause its fixture goal. The evaluation operator explicitly reviews and activates the revised goal once at evaluation start. Any subsequent measurement pause remains authoritative; no evaluation auto-resume.
infeasible_rule: Cumulative goal target equals current observed objective value plus current physical stock plus one. No feasibility is inferred from held-out demand.
setup_checks: identical observable starting world and budgets across arms
discount ceiling zero and action absent in no-discount case
all declared low-stock/thin-margin fixture values applied
adverse prior measurement actually breached or explicitly reported uninformative
day-2 campaign coefficient schedule applied identically without exposing it to planner
uninformative_rule: Report fixtures whose observed evidence does not test the intended condition as uninformative; never resample to force a favorable comparison. Numerical recipe is frozen before development or held-out case calls. Standalone integration smoke attempts are not these evaluation cases.
